intro: Every practice on the calendar, and every practice on its own page. The number is what carries the teaching order — a rainout moves the whole schedule down one instead of skipping it — and the date is only where that number happens to land. Built one practice at a time: nothing gets installed before its prerequisite is in place.

preseason.label: Before the first game
preseason.note: Alignment first, plays second — every kid knows his spot and we count seven on the line before anybody touches the ball. A formation run without thinking beats six plays half known.

season.label: Once the season starts
season.note: One new look at a time, and only once the last one has hurt somebody. Each exists because a defence started cheating something — not worth installing before that happens.

practices.focus: Line up in the Regular I
practices.emphasis: Install the formation itself — alignment only, no plays. Every kid knows his spot, and we count seven on the line every single snap until it is boring.
practices.finisher: First unit vs. second unit sprint relay race.

practices.focus: Line up in the Regular I again
practices.emphasis: The same formation install. Reps on alignment and the seven-on-the-line count until they can do it without thinking — then we are ready to hand somebody the ball.
practices.finisher: First unit vs. second unit sprint relay race.

practices.emphasis: Two runs, two different jobs. Dive hits fast off the double team before the linebackers can read it — snap to handoff under a second. Wedge is short yardage: nobody blocks a man, the whole line squeezes to the center's back and pushes. Same formation, same snap count — first time somebody besides the coach is naming who gets the ball.
practices.finisher: First unit vs. second unit sprint relay race.

practices.focus: Go live and set the first team
agility_drills: Warm-ups — lap, dynamic stretch, form running (10 min)
Station 1 — tackling: approach, break down, wrap and drive (15 min)
Station 2 — blocking: fit, hands inside, drive the feet (15 min)
Two groups, swap on the whistle — every kid does both stations
practices.emphasis: No new install. Everything we already have — Dive and Wedge, both ways out of the Regular I — goes live for the rest of practice, and the point is personnel, not plays. Run the same handful over and over against a real look and watch who moves people, who finds the hole without being told and who tackles in space. Nobody gets a spot on reputation: the kid who does it live is the kid who starts.
practices.huddle: Name the first team out loud, and the first sub at every spot.

practices.focus: Fundamentals both ways, Power and Pitch, live scrimmage

practices.emphasis: One long block after the warm-up. Review S-1 and S-2 — Slot Right 38 Pitch and Slot Left 29 Pitch. The 3-back is always the left back (odd holes); the 2-back is always the right back (even holes).

practices.focus: Iso, Power and the Toss — inside, off-tackle and the edge
practices.emphasis: Three calls, three places on the field. Iso hits the gap the line opens, Power hits off-tackle behind the kick-out, and the Toss goes round it all — same backfield, three answers.
